proposedContracts.name: matches native RSO mux bytes from raw u8 and WAV s16le inputs for three rates and six lengths
proposedContracts.scope: pcm_u8 mono RSO mux from raw u8 and WAV s16le, rates 8000/11025/65535, lengths 0-70000 bytes, size field min(data,0xffff); seekable native output.

proposedContracts.name: refuses RSO rates of 65536 and above stereo and pcm_s16le with native exit 183 before output creation
proposedContracts.scope: Native exit 183 for rate >= 65536, stereo and non-pcm_u8 codecs, before Edge output creation.

proposedContracts.name: matches native RSO demux of native-written and short or long header-size files through copy framecrc WAV decode and seeks
proposedContracts.scope: pcm_u8 RSO demux read to EOF regardless of header size, through copy framecrc, WAV and pcm_s16le framecrc, with -ss/-t/-frames.

proposedContracts.name: detects undeclared RSO only by extension and refuses ADPCM and unknown tags with native exit 176
proposedContracts.scope: Undeclared detection only by .rso extension; -f rso; tag 0x0101/unknown refused with native exit 176.

notes: Native has no read_probe; the registry demux.extensions hook is used, so undeclared detection needs a .rso path.
Native creates (empty) output files on its write_header refusals; Edge refuses before output creation as the registry contract requires.
Setup durations: submodule init 44s, npm ci 10s, reference:build 180s, baseline static checks 59s, baseline unit suite 84s.
No shared edits beyond the registry line were needed.
